hero.description: Analyze a video, explore output options, and keep every conversion in one clear place.

source.title: Add a source
source.description: Paste a YouTube URL to inspect source metadata. Conversion requires operator-authorized network access and permission to process the media.
source.hint: Metadata analysis requests source information without downloading a media file.

preview.title: Media preview
preview.empty_description: Analyze a source to view its details.
preview.streams_description: These are streams reported by YouTube. Output choices below may require conversion or audio merging.

output.title: Choose your format
output.settings_notice: Available settings depend on the source. Higher output settings cannot improve source quality.
output.worker_ready: Output quality cannot exceed the source. Conversion also requires operator-authorized network access and permission to process the media.
output.rights: I confirm I have permission to process this media

progress.title: Current work
progress.empty_description: Progress and download details will show here after a job starts.

history.title: Recent work
history.empty_description: Your recent conversions will appear here.

messages.network_error: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
messages.analysis_unavailable: Media analysis is not available yet.
messages.service_unavailable: The service is unavailable. Please try again later.
messages.no_output: No conversion output is available for this source.
messages.choose_output: Media analyzed. Choose an available output. Conversion requires authorized network access and media-processing permission.
messages.format_unavailable: Media analyzed. {format} unavailable: {reason}. Choose an available output.

errors.network_restricted: Conversion is restricted to authorized networks.
errors.default: The request could not be completed.

legal.notice: Before converting, review copyright permissions, platform terms, and applicable law. Analysis and available formats do not grant permission.

footer.description: Built for clear, controlled media workflows.

restricted.title: Restricted Service Access
restricted.description: This installation permits conversion only from hosts and networks authorized by its operator. Metadata analysis does not grant permission to download or convert media.
